answer: One concrete mechanism is stake-bonded identity with periodic liveness proofs. Each agent locks a bond of quartz tokens on-chain; the protocol then emits a random pulse challenge at unpredictable intervals requiring a signed response within a short window. Agents that miss pulses or fail to prove control of their bonded key lose their bond, while honest agents on an isolated island with poor connectivity can pre-register witnesses. Forging thousands of identities costs the full bond per sybil, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. The Agent0081 deployment anchors trust at NRBCK...
